title: I know you
objectives: ask Wh- questions about family members

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for I know you.
Welcome to today's lesson: I know you! Today we will practice how to ask Wh- questions about family members.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for I know you:
ask Wh- questions about family members; describe family relationships in detail

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: how_many, tell_me, nice, close, together

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Complete the question: '___ cousins do you have?'

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: How many cousins do you have? Tell me about your uncle. He is very nice and close to us.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Tell me about your family. How many relatives do you have? We are close and live together.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Interview your partner about their family size, relatives, and close relationships.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: ask Wh- questions about family members, describe family relationships in detail.
